subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “For Mother's Day, Eric tried to bake a cake.”?
options: The recipe asked for one spoon of sugar, but Kevin added one spoon of salt by mistake.
Mrs. Lin says people and fruit are sometimes judged too quickly by appearance.
Instead of only counting the bottles, he asked everyone to read the words on them.
He read the recipe too quickly and added salt instead of sugar.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The recipe asked for one spoon of sugar, but Kevin added one spoon of salt by mistake.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Mrs. Lin says people and fruit are sometimes judged too quickly by appearance.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Instead of only counting the bottles, he asked everyone to read the words on them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「He read the recipe too quickly and added salt instead of sugar.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
